note: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands: every visitor, whatever the nationality, must get the Commissioner's permission to land in advance (taken as a visa, British citizens included); paying passengers of cruise ships and yachts are covered by their master's permit (not modelled). Read from Wikipedia's copy (the territory's immigration pages publish no list this client can read).

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policies of British Overseas Territories
sources.said: The Commissioner of South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands , based in Stanley , regulates all access to the territory. All visitors irrespective of their nationality or mode of transport must apply to the Commissioner for permission to land in advance.
